# openmetadata_topic (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata topic. A topic belongs to a messaging service and records its partitions, retention and message schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_messaging_service" "events" {
  name         = "events"
  service_type = "Kafka"
}

resource "openmetadata_topic" "order_created" {
  name        = "order_created"
  service     = openmetadata_messaging_service.events.fully_qualified_name
  description = "Emitted whenever an order is created."
  partitions  = 3

  retention_time   = 604800000
  retention_size   = 1073741824
  cleanup_policies = ["delete"]

  message_schema = jsonencode({
    schemaType = "JSON"
    schemaText = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"orderId\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Topic name. Changing it replaces the topic, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `partitions` (Number) Number of partitions. The server requires it at creation.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent messaging service. Changing it replaces the topic.

### Optional

- `cleanup_policies` (List of String) Cleanup policies, compact and/or delete. Filled by the server when omitted.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the topic.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `maximum_message_size` (Number) Maximum message size in bytes. Filled by the server when omitted.
- `message_schema` (String) Message schema as a JSON object string with schemaType, schemaText and schemaFields keys.
- `minimum_in_sync_replicas` (Number) Minimum number of in-sync replicas.
- `replication_factor` (Number) Replication factor.
- `retention_size` (Number) Retention size in bytes.
- `retention_time` (Number) Retention time in milliseconds.
- `topic_config` (String) Broker configuration as a JSON object string.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.topic.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_topic.order_created 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.topic.
terraform import openmetadata_topic.order_created events.order_created
```
